exercises.instruction: What do you say in these situations? Write sentences with I wish … would … .

answers: I wish it would stop raining.

items.prompt: You say to yourself: I wish she
answers: I wish she would hurry up.
I wish somebody would give me a job.
I wish the/that dog would stop barking.

items.prompt: You say to her: I wish you
answers: I wish you wouldn't drive so fast.
I wish you wouldn't leave the door open (all the time).
I wish people wouldn't drop litter in the street.
